verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a 3D scene library, for example batching or instancing many objects. The axis therefore applies, but no evidence item documents a three.js capability for acting on many items at once. The release note on setGeometryIdAt() and the mentions of compute shaders do not describe a bulk-operation feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
